text_block_list.name: Royce in Past Event Footage
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, everyooone! Thank you sho much
for coming to shee Royce!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
…………
I fumbled my line right here.
No matter how many times I rewatch it, I totally fumbled it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The problem... isn't stumbling over words
in and of itself.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It sounded like a leaking tire—
not cute at all the way you fumbled that sentence!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, to show such an unpolished side in front of all my fans... I still have a long way to go...!
I need to focus even more on my self-branding...!
